title: TagDuel 2v2 End Phase six-card hand limit and physical discard ownership
scenarios: A classic four-seat TagDuel begins with seat 0 active. Three real cards are moved from that physical seat's Deck into its hand to create a seven-card End Phase fixture without duplicating UIDs. End Turn must enter discard phase before seat 1 draws; after JSON restore, only seat 0 can discard; the hand becomes six and seat 1 draws exactly one card when the turn advances.
A seven-card hand during Main Phase does not expose discard actions; the six-card check is deferred until End Phase rather than applied at draw time.
invariants: Discard is performed by the physical owner of the active hand, not their inactive teammate.
The next physical seat's top Deck card is untouched until the outgoing End Phase discard completes.
After End Phase, the outgoing hand has six, the next seat has one additional card, and its Deck has decreased by one.
The inactive partner's private hand remains unchanged.
JSON restoration during discard preserves the active decision owner.
The full physical UID-to-card-ID inventory is conserved.
limits: Tests use the real compiled TagDuel and duel engine modules, with an in-memory state fixture.
The seven-card condition is created by moving existing physical cards from the Deck, not by granting inventory.
No runtime, resolver, catalog manifest, allowlist, persistent database or player data is modified.
This verifies a rules invariant but does not certify a new card behavior.
No live Discord API session is performed.
command: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/tagEndPhaseHandLimit2v2.test.cjs
